execution.ref: VALIDATOR-09 slice 1, branch claude/validator-09-score-variants. Canonical: score-variant tests and both unreachability invariants passed; the results are recorded in the PR.
execution.description: Development score variants are registered before they are served, carry the score-tuning registry's candidate entry verbatim and score only through its functions, and no miner surface can reach them.

expected: A score variant could have its own weighting format and re-scorer over stored rows.
observed: Two formats would drift: the Test Lead required one candidate definition, so a variant wraps the score-tuning entry (#650) and a parity test proves byte-identical rescoring. The registry lives outside carbon/challenge_validator, itself a walked miner surface, so the Challenge declares its legs as data only.
keep: One definition per concept: a promoted candidate is the same entry, scored by the same code, under both registries.
Prove a development-only module is unreachable with both the static import walk and a fresh-interpreter import of every door.
change: Agree a shared shape with the other registry's owner before either registry grows.
protocol_elements: every Challenge's score development registers candidate weightings before computing them and keeps them unreachable from miners
